name: Modem
description: Platform that gathers customer feedback from support tickets, sales calls and chat and groups it into topics for product and engineering teams.
notes: modem.dev redirects to modem.ai. BetaKit calls it Toronto-based (founder Ben Vinegar); no street address. Jobs link on site but no roles seen.

name: Molagri
description: Develops engineered biopesticides that target specific pests to control them with less environmental impact.
notes: YC Summer 2026. BetaKit says Toronto-based; founders Zaky Hassan and Min Jin. Merged with duplicate id molagri.com. Site has Join the team buttons but no listed roles.

name: Molagri
notes: duplicate of name:molagri

name: Moonshot Brands
description: Bought and grew profitable e-commerce companies selling on Amazon and direct to consumer.
notes: YC Winter 2021 (YC lists Toronto; CB Insights lists Miami, so HQ is weakly confirmed). moonshotbrands.com now redirects to infinitecommerce.com, which redirects to razor-group.com; Infinite Commerce merged with Razor Group in Aug 2025 (Berlin/Boston). The Moonshot-to-Infinite Commerce link is inferred from the redirect, not confirmed by an article.

name: Moonvalley
description: AI research lab building licensed-data video generation models (Marey) for filmmakers and creators.
notes: BetaKit: HQ Toronto, founded 2023, about 100 employees (about a dozen in Canada), USD 154M raised in total. Stage is set from the round label (seed extension). Careers page exists, roles not seen. Merged with duplicate id moonvalley.com.

name: Moonvalley
notes: duplicate of name:moonvalley

name: MoveMate
notes: HQ Montreal (917 avenue Mont-Royal E per movemate.ca; PitchBook and Dealroom agree), not GTA. Acquired by MovingWaldo (May 2026 per PitchBook). Sources: https://www.movemate.ca/ and https://fi.co/insight/founder-institute-montreal-grad-s-movemate-acquired-by-movingwaldo

name: Movia
description: Mobile billboard advertising on trucks, combined with analytics and retargeting (formerly HaulerAds).
notes: Rebranded from HaulerAds (HaulerAds Inc.). Trucknews describes it as Toronto-based; founder/CEO Casey Binkley. Founded 2015 per a company blog. Site lists 416 and 212 phone numbers, no street address.

name: Naborly
description: Tenant screening and rental credit reporting platform for landlords.
notes: YC Winter 2018. naborly.com redirects to singlekey.com, whose site links press coverage of the acquisition; one aggregator lists Naborly acquired by SingleKey in Oct 2022. Fathom Holdings' 10-K also says it bought substantially all Naborly assets in 2021 (about USD 2.7M), so the chain of ownership is not fully clear. Toronto location from YC listing only.

name: NextGen Sound
notes: nextgensound.io redirects to nxtgenhq.com (NxtGen, artist ad-automation platform); Caplight lists it in Sydney, no Toronto evidence. Sources: http://www.nxtgenhq.com/ and https://www.caplight.com/company/nxtgenhq

name: Nimbus
description: Platform for universities and colleges to manage tutoring, mentorship and advising programs.
notes: Nimbus Learning. G2 lists HQ Toronto, founded 2017. Street address differs across directories, so left null. The site displayed unrelated casino ad content when fetched (possible compromise).

name: NuPort Robotics
description: Toronto autonomous trucking company building a retrofit system for automated heavy-duty trucks.
notes: Toronto-based per ITBusiness and Built In Toronto (about 10 employees; CEO Raghavender Sahdev). Website not confirmed (nuportrobotics.com fetch failed). CB Insights address looks residential and unconfirmed, so not used. Status active assumed from press; no recent check.

name: Off2Class
description: English language learning curriculum and tools for K-12 teachers, EFL teachers and schools.
notes: Wellfound lists HQ Toronto. Street address differs across directories, so left null.

name: OnCall Health
description: White-label telehealth and virtual care platform for healthcare organizations, now part of Qualifacts.
notes: Acquired by Qualifacts (Nashville) in Nov 2022. Series A date is year only (2020); day set to 01 as placeholder. Domain is the acquirer's site.

name: OneLocal
description: Digital marketing and CRM platform for local businesses.
notes: YC Summer 2017. CB Insights lists 545 King Street West, Toronto, other sources say CityPlace; not confirmed by the company, so address left null. Careers page linked, roles not seen.

name: Open Screenplay
description: Online platform for screenwriters with writing and collaboration tools, contests and an AI writing assistant.
notes: Toronto-based per 2019 CNW release and CB Insights; founder Khaled Sabawi.

name: OpenCode
description: Open source AI coding agent for the terminal, IDE and desktop, built by Anomaly.
notes: Built by Anomaly (Jay V, Frank Wang; YC W2021, formerly SST). YC lists Toronto, 24 employees; Everydev lists San Francisco, so HQ is only weakly confirmed. No careers page on site.

name: OpenSports
description: Software for managing sports leagues, tournaments, pickup games and memberships.
notes: Directories place it in Toronto; launched 2016 by James Gibbons per a 2019 profile. Caplight lists opensports.net as the website; opensports.ca site is live.

name: OpenUnit
description: Software for managing self-storage facilities, including online booking, payments and marketing.
notes: YC Winter 2020. Jobs page lists two remote engineering roles; page says the company was founded in Toronto. YC lists Toronto, 5 people, founder Taylor Cooney.

name: Oppos
description: Cybersecurity services and AI-driven compliance automation (penetration testing, vCISO, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
notes: Site lists HQ at 1033 McNicoll Ave, Scarborough (part of Toronto); input city Mississauga was incorrect. No careers page seen.
address: 1033 McNicoll Ave, 1st Floor, Scarborough, ON M1W 3W6

name: Optimity
description: Micro-learning and rewards app for employee health and wellness programs.
notes: Toronto HQ per CB Insights and other directories (formerly myHealthSphere); founding year conflicts (2014 vs 2016), so left null. Site footer says 2024 copyright, so activity is less certain. Careers link exists, roles not checked.

name: OPTT Inc.
description: Virtual behavioral health platform for psychotherapists to deliver clinically validated interactive therapy.
notes: OPTT Health. Toronto per CB Insights (DMZ, 10 Dundas St E). optt.ca returned 403 so could not be checked; Caplight lists optt.health as the website. Status not confirmed.

name: Opusense AI
description: AI-native field operations platform and mobile app that generates field inspection reports for construction.
notes: YC Spring 2025; site says Built in Toronto; founders Roya Cody and Michael Bacani. No careers page on site.

name: Origami XR
description: Cloud software that turns 3D and LiDAR scans into walkable AR/VR digital twins.
notes: Toronto per CENGN and CDL profiles (founder Erik Peterson), dated around 2021. The website now shows a Manifold login (scanmanifold.com); a DMZ Manifold profile exists, so it may be a rebrand, but this is unconfirmed. Current status unknown.

name: Ownright
description: Digital real estate law firm handling property closings, refinancing and status certificate reviews in Ontario.
notes: Formerly Doormat; Toronto-based per BetaKit. Founded 2022 per BetaKit (another source says 2023). Total raised 6.5M including pre-seed. A directory lists 20 De Boers Drive Suite 300 but it is secondary, so address left null.
